summary.name: aiXcoder
summary.one_liner: aiXcoder is an enterprise software-development platform from Peking University's Institute of Software Engineering offering coding agents, small domain-tuned code models, and the Enterprise Hub control platform for on-premise deployment.
use_cases: automate enterprise R&D tasks from requirements to delivery
merge AI-generated code snippets into source files
generate test cases and scripts automatically
generate C control-algorithm code from design documents
deploy a private code LLM on own compute
govern and share agents, models and knowledge bases across teams
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a multi-agent system covering requirement understanding, task decomposition, code generation, test verification and delivery for complex R&D work. It pairs large models for global decisions with small models for high-frequency, deterministic subtasks. Its open-source aiXapply-4B model (May 2026) is said to apply code changes accurately on a single consumer RTX 4090. Enterprise Hub is a control platform for configuring, auditing and sharing agents, models, MCPs, Skills and knowledge bases, and for codebase program analysis. Case studies cite deployments in banking, aerospace, energy and telecom, with figures such as 35%+ of code AI-generated at a bank and a 70%+ test-case acceptance rate in telecom.
notable: Small open-source aiXapply-4B model for merging code changes, runnable on one consumer GPU
Enterprise Hub control platform for agent governance and auditing
Fully on-premise deployment, including domestic chips
Case studies in banking, aerospace, nuclear energy and telecom
caveats: Enterprise offering is delivered via needs assessment, POC and private rollout, so pricing is not listed on the page
Performance figures are self-reported by the vendor and tied to specific case studies
